blocks.text: BANGKOK, Thailand — China and Laos have inaugurated a joint military facility at an airport north of the Laotian capital, both governments said, extending the Chinese military’s reach in the region. Beijing has long sought to increase its influence across Asia-Pacific, competing with Washington and its allies over key shipping routes and undersea resource exploration. China has also extended its military presence, especially in the disputed South China Sea — which it claims almost entirely — by building up artificial islands and reefs, and militarising them with runways, ports and radar systems.
